component.name: WebHTTrack Website Copier
component.summary: Copy websites to your computer for offline browsing

description.p: WebHTTrack is the web interface to HTTrack, an offline browser utility. It downloads a website from the Internet to a local directory, fetching the HTML, images, and other files and rebuilding the site's link structure so you can browse it offline.
A step-by-step web interface guides you through choosing the addresses to mirror and the options to apply. Mirrors can be updated in place and interrupted downloads resumed.

ul.li: Keeping an offline copy of a website for reading without a connection
Archiving or preserving sites and capturing them for later reference
Updating an existing local mirror without downloading it again

screenshot.caption: Choosing the addresses and options for a new mirror

ul.li: The version number moves to 3.50, matching the Windows and Android releases built on this engine
WebHTTrack itself is unchanged since 3.49.25
The About box credits the people who translated your language
A crash report prints the signal number the right way round
Links to httrack.com open over https
A mirror the engine gave up on no longer reports success
Updating a mirror no longer deletes pages the site still has
A full disk is reported instead of being read as the end of a file
Scripts are scanned for links whichever content type the server gives them
An option written as --name=value is read as it was written
WebHTTrack help and the File menu stay reachable once a crawl has started
Every language file is now stored in Unicode
A header you add by hand is no longer sent twice
Rebuilding the top index no longer leaves it blank while it is being written
WebHTTrack now saves and restores the proxy, and no longer offers a mirror mode it cannot run
Settings saved in one interface reopen unchanged in the others
The language menu shows every language in its own name and script
A long address or a long robots.txt rule no longer stops or misreads the mirror
When the mirror asks whether to follow a link, you can now answer for a whole domain instead of that one address
Your answer is applied to the rest of the mirror and written to the log, instead of deciding a single link
The footer added to mirrored pages takes named fields, so a custom one keeps working when the list grows
A long address, a long filter, a large cookies file or a large robots.txt no longer stops the mirror
A redirection to a long address is followed instead of being refused
Every language now has the text added since 3.49, and WebHTTrack quits when its window is closed
A site that answers to several names is mirrored once, instead of once per name
Stopping a mirror ends the transfers under way instead of reporting them as network errors
A mirror that ends early no longer deletes files the update pass never reached
Reloading a project keeps the boxes you cleared and the values you set to zero
Clearing the option to build an index page now turns it off
A very long address, or a very large settings file, no longer stops the mirror
Refreshed screenshots throughout the documentation
A link pointing to another site is no longer mistaken for a page of your own and mirrored in full
A mirror told to quit while an FTP file is being received now stops, instead of hanging
Stopping an FTP download no longer closes its connection twice, which could interrupt another download
The welcome page's language menu shows the language in use
The macOS download says in its name that it is for Apple Silicon
Refreshed screenshots and typography throughout the documentation
Stopping a mirror now takes effect at once, instead of waiting for connections that were still being opened
A mirror that stops early keeps its web archive and its list of changes
A partly downloaded file the server refuses to resume is fetched again rather than lost
An FTP site that stops responding no longer blocks a download for five minutes
A very long web address or FTP path no longer crashes the mirror
Stopping a mirror while an FTP file is downloading no longer crashes
An FTP address carrying an over-long user name could sign in as a different account
Updated Turkish translation
The program itself is unchanged: this release only fixes building HTTrack from source on some Linux distributions and processors
A mirrored page opened in your browser can no longer take control of the WebHTTrack interface
Web addresses shown while a mirror runs no longer break the progress page
Settings keep values containing quotes or ampersands, and Windows paths such as C:\ab
A malformed link on a crawled site can no longer alter the requests HTTrack sends
Crash reports name the function and source line where the problem occurred
The application has its own icon in the desktop menu, at any screen size
Option tooltips no longer break in languages whose text contains quotes or other special characters
Croatian, Macedonian, Polish, Slovak, Slovenian and Swedish text no longer shows as mangled characters
Pages that failed with an "Invalid chunk" error now download correctly
A very long web address no longer aborts the whole mirror
Save a page and everything it needs as one self-contained file
Read a site's sitemap, so pages nothing links to are still found
See what a new pass added, updated or removed
Updating a mirror no longer destroys a good local copy when a download fails or is interrupted
In the web interface, options ticked by default can be un-ticked again, the size limit applies to the whole site, and the finished mirror opens from its link
Save a mirror as a web archive, indexed and packaged for replay
Choose what the page footer says
A mirror saved to a folder with accented characters in its name lands in the right place
Mirror through a SOCKS5 proxy
Files of 2 GB and over are handled correctly on Windows and on 32-bit systems
The web interface offers options that used to be command-line only, among them a cookies file and a pause between downloads

description.p: Links carrying accented characters are followed again, a page wrongly labelled as compressed is no longer lost, and a new option explains why a given address is kept or skipped.

ul.li: Audio and video sources are mirrored along with the page
A site's robots.txt is followed more closely, including its Allow rules and wildcards
A time limit now stops a slow download instead of waiting for it to end
Start from a cookies file, and space downloads out with a random pause
Ignore chosen query parameters when naming saved files
Resuming a partial download no longer duplicates bytes

description.p: Saved files get the right type when the server and the address disagree about it.

ul.li: Secure downloads can go through a plain web proxy
Every size of a responsive image is fetched
